info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Site Operation Operational Action-spec
info.description: The Site Operations Management API enables businesses to initiate and manage operational actions related to site facilities. This API allows users to create new operational actions that streamline processes crucial for maintaining effective site operations. Typical consumers include facility managers and operations teams who require efficient tools for automation and workflow enhancement. By utilizing this API, organizations can improve the agility of their operational response and ensure optimal functionality across their sites.

post.summary: Create a new operational action for facility management.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new operational action tailored to facility management. Input appropriate data to initiate the action. Ensure all required fields are populated to avoid errors during the action creation process.
